citation.authors: Al-Naseem A, Sallam A, Choudhury S

cited_by.title: Low haemoglobin, low or high white cells: causes, thresholds and pregnancy

record.population: Review of iron deficiency with and without anaemia
record.finding: Iron deficiency without anaemia is at least twice as common as iron deficiency anaemia and is poorly recognised. Diagnosis relies on a combination of tests: haemoglobin, ferritin and transferrin saturation.
